title: PMosFM: Preconditioned Manifold Matching for One-Step Physics-Constrained Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.40287v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-constrained generative models aim to generate physical fields that match a target distribution and satisfy prescribed constraints. However, enforcing these constraints often increases sampling costs through iterative corrections or training costs through residual optimization and trajectory unrolling. To address this issue, we introduce \textbf{P}reconditioned \textbf{M}anifold \textbf{o}ne-\textbf{s}tep \textbf{F}low \textbf{M}atching (\textbf{PMosFM}), a preconditioned manifold matching framework for one-step physics-constrained generation. By encoding constraints in a manifold decoder, PMosFM learns transport in intrinsic coordinates without separate residual losses or terminal residual unrolling. A geometric preconditioner rescales coordinates using the decoder-induced metric, while a regularized covariance transform approximately whitens the interpolation-state inputs. A finite-interval objective couples velocity supervision

translated_title: PMosFM：用于单步物理约束生成的预条件流形匹配
translated_abstract: 物理约束生成模型旨在生成既匹配目标分布又满足给定约束的物理场。然而，施加这些约束往往会通过迭代校正增加采样成本，或通过残差优化与轨迹展开增加训练成本。为解决这一问题，我们提出了**预条件流形单步流匹配**（**P**reconditioned **M**anifold one-step **F**low **M**atching，**PMosFM**），一个用于单步物理约束生成的预条件流形匹配框架。通过在流形解码器中编码约束，PMosFM 在内蕴坐标中学习输运，无需单独的残差损失或终端残差展开。几何预条件子利用解码器诱导的度量对坐标进行重缩放，同时正则化协方差变换将近似白化插值状态的输入。有限区间目标函数将速度监督……
tldr: PMosFM 通过流形解码器编码物理约束，结合几何预条件与协方差白化变换，实现了无需残差损失或迭代校正的单步物理约束生成，显著降低了训练与采样成本。
en_tdlr: PMosFM enables one-step physics-constrained generation by encoding constraints in a manifold decoder with a geometric preconditioner and covariance whitening, eliminating the need for residual losses or iterative corrections.
